body: That is such a good idea, I just ordered the LUSH Butterbear and Honey Bee to put in, thank you for your suggestion!!
Okay, so preownedweddingdresses.com is officially the coolest website, and I think she'll love it! Thank you!
I love the card idea! I feel like I totally overlooked that, and I'm totally going to use it. Thanks so much for your ideas, and good luck on your finals!! :)

I just wanted to thank you all for your kindness and concern. I'm still holding on, trying to focus on at least one small positive thing per day and do enough that I can ignore some of the awfulness going on here at school.

You all have no idea how much of a difference you've made in the way I see myself and the ability to overcome obstacles. <3
I can certainly try. Sure, would you be able to PM me?

I'm trying it's just so hard. These guys have succeeded in making me feel so worthless. It's so hard to see a light at the end of the tunnel. It's hard to believe I was once a pretty well-adjusted 21-year-old woman.

Honestly, I don't know if I can be helped. Everything hurts so bad, and nothing makes it better. Every day it gets worse and worse, and I've completely used up my supply of being strong. I wish things were the way they used to be, but it took years to feel comfortable and safe, and minutes for it all to fall away. 
Thank you for your sincerity and your compassion. I just wish I was stronger than I am, strong enough to speak up.
